7. Promote the business: Finally, promote your business through advertising, social media, and other marketing channels. Encourage your customers to refer others to your business and reward them for doing so.

Remember, starting an MLM business requires hard work, dedication, and persistence. It may not be easy at first, but with the right mindset and approach, you can build a successful business and achieve financial freedom.
